Executive overview

This report shows the selected tenant’s Microsoft 365 licence products, seat allocation and enabled subscription lifecycle information from CIPP’s reporting data. It supports capacity and renewal planning.

Seat totals are summed across products, so one identity holding two products uses two seats. Available seats are not automatically refundable. Commercial dates and prices should be confirmed with the CSP before making changes.
